Integrated Solutions for Systems, Inc. (IS4S) is hiring a PNT Software Engineer to develop embedded software for assured positioning, navigation, and timing systems. The role includes implementing navigation algorithms, integrating sensors and hardware, and testing resilient navigation solutions.
Industrial
Manufacturing
Industrial Engineering
Service Industry
Growth Opportunities
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded software components for assured PNT systems using modern C++
Implement and support navigation algorithms that process data from inertial sensors, GPS/GNSS receivers, clocks, and other navigation sources
Develop and maintain software interfaces to sensors, embedded hardware, and host platforms
Integrate software components with navigation hardware and platform systems, troubleshooting hardware/software interface issues
Develop and execute unit, integration, and system-level tests to verify software functionality and performance
Analyze test results, investigate defects, and support debugging and performance optimization
Use Git-based version control, automated build systems, and CI/CD pipelines to support software quality and repeatable development workflows
Collaborate with systems, hardware, and navigation engineers to develop, integrate, and demonstrate assured PNT capabilities
